coverage.method: Independently decoded clean WAV samples;10ms RMS bins active above max(.002,7% maximum clip-bin RMS). Compare active-bin midpoint to that cue’s real caption frames; silence and uncaptioned inter-cue breaths need no text.

layoutEstimate.method: Conservative one-em-per-character static estimate of the single-line source style; not actual font raster bounds or a rendered occlusion test.

limits: These are measured audio/timeline, static source, compile and optional encoded-file checks. They do not certify visual beauty, organ/model visibility, text occlusion, camera intent, or subjective narration quality.
A screenshot/contact sheet is not a substitute for full-motion and final-film inspection.
No full MP4 is claimed until the default delivery file exists and is successfully probed; release approval remains a separate visual/listening decision.
